subtasks.objective: Harden the serve_kot endpoint so serving a KOT cannot be forged by arbitrary authenticated users or with caller-supplied production times.
subtasks.acceptance: serve_kot only accepts POST requests, loads the target URY KOT, verifies the session user has an appropriate kitchen/manager role and is authorized for the KOT branch, rejects unauthorized or cross-branch requests, records the served timestamp from the server instead of trusting a request parameter, and existing legitimate KOT serving flow continues to work.
